name: multiturn_topic_v1
description: 12 multi-turn conversations for follow-up topic tracking. Each turn has the topic the answer must be about (null = not a medical question; the answer must just not discuss another disease). Written without opening the corpus and committed before its first run. Measures the share of turns answered about the right topic, instead of patching individual phrasings.
